questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: Cargo (rust-version 1.96, edition 2024). No separate install step: `cargo build` (add --release) fetches dependencies; `cargo fetch` just prefetches.
accept: cargo build / cargo build --release / cargo fetch

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: CI: `cargo test --verbose --workspace` (also with `--features pcre2`; ci/test-complete for zsh completions). The workspace flag matters: the root package alone is only `rg`.

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in tests/regression.rs?
questions.truth: tests/regression.rs is a module (`mod regression;`) of the single integration test binary `integration` (tests/tests.rs; [[test]] name = "integration", autotests = false). So: `cargo test --test integration regression`.
reject: cargo test --test regression (no such test target; fails)
cargo test regression = 0.5 (works loosely, across all binaries)

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI runs `cargo fmt --all --check` (rustfmt.toml) and `cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace`. CI does NOT run clippy.
accept: cargo fmt --all --check / cargo fmt --all -- --check / cargo fmt --check (cargo doc check a bonus)

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: None that must not be hand-edited, apart from tool-managed Cargo.lock and gitignored target/.
reject: claiming crates/*, tests/data or pkg/ are generated or vendored
